dedupe_keys.name: communal public services performance indicators for moldovan towns serviciicomunale md adept

description: The serviciicomunale.md portal of the Association for Participatory Democracy (ADEPT) compares how local public administrations in Moldovan municipalities and towns deliver communal services, using an extended set of indicators for water supply, sewerage and wastewater treatment, sanitation and waste collection, public street lighting, local passenger transport and road infrastructure. Each town has a profile, such as Cahul, with values by year from 2019 to 2022: for water, access, continuity, compliance with drinking water standards, losses, tariffs, operating costs, cost recovery, network accident rates per kilometre and interruptions; for roads, the shares of paved and light roads in good, satisfactory or poor condition; for lighting, street coverage, energy use and efficient lamps; and for waste, collection frequency, landfills and snow clearing. Indicators can be compared across the 34 listed towns. The project page says all data comes from local authorities and open data sources, that the site was updated in 2023 with EU support through the Open Government Partnership, and that it was first built with UK aid. Access is free; no licence is stated. Caveats: many indicators show no data where a town did not report, and the latest year shown is 2022. Coverage is Moldova at town level. It supports service performance and resilience analysis of local water, road and lighting systems; the related record is the Icelandic infrastructure asset inventory.
